findings.title: Decoupling cap C204 far from via
findings.description: C204 is 4.1mm from the nearest via (~2.9nH connection inductance). Long traces between cap and via degrade high-frequency decoupling effectiveness.
findings.recommendation: Place a via directly adjacent to C204 pads. Use fat, short traces from cap pads to via.
findings.summary: Decoupling cap C204 far from via

findings.title: Decoupling cap C106 far from via
findings.description: C106 is 3.1mm from the nearest via (~2.2nH connection inductance). Long traces between cap and via degrade high-frequency decoupling effectiveness.
findings.recommendation: Place a via directly adjacent to C106 pads. Use fat, short traces from cap pads to via.
findings.summary: Decoupling cap C106 far from via

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J201
findings.description: Connector J201 (BNC) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J201 has proper ground connection to chassis/enclosure. Add ESD protection if connected to external antenna.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J201

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J1001
findings.description: J1001 (Conn_01x06) has 1 ground pin(s) for 4 signal pins. Recommended: at least 2 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J1001 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J1001

findings.recommendation: Route clock signals on inner layers (stripline) when possible.

findings.title: Clock /usb_fifo/FT_CLKOUT_S routed near connector J501
findings.description: Clock net /usb_fifo/FT_CLKOUT_S passes within 10.0mm of connector J501. Clock harmonics can couple to attached cables via proximity, increasing radiated emissions.
findings.recommendation: Route /usb_fifo/FT_CLKOUT_S away from J501, or add ground guard traces between the clock and connector.
findings.summary: Clock /usb_fifo/FT_CLKOUT_S routed near connector J501

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (100×80mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 715 MHz; (0,1) at 893 MHz; (1,1) at 1144 MHz; (2,0) at 1429 MHz; (2,1) at 1685 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: SD_DQ2
findings.description: Net SD_DQ2 has 6 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 6 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: SD_DQ2

findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /adc/DA_ADC1

findings.title: 21+ nets missing stitching vias (truncated)
findings.description: More than 20 nets have layer transitions without nearby ground stitching vias. Review via placement board-wide.
findings.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias at all signal layer transitions.
findings.summary: 21+ nets missing stitching vias (truncated)

findings.title: Single ground via near ESD device U501
findings.description: U501 (esd_ic) has 1 ground via within 3mm. Multiple parallel vias reduce ground inductance. Two vias halve the inductance (~0.5nH → ~0.25nH).
findings.recommendation: Add a second ground via near U501 for lower inductance.
findings.summary: Single ground via near ESD device U501

findings.title: U601 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band
findings.description: U601 (TLV62569DBVR) switching at 0.5 MHz has 117 harmonics in the 30-88 MHz band (harmonics 60-176). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U601. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U601 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band

findings.title: U601 harmonics in 88-216 MHz band
findings.description: U601 (TLV62569DBVR) switching at 0.5 MHz has 257 harmonics in the 88-216 MHz band (harmonics 176-432). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U601. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U601 harmonics in 88-216 MHz band

findings.title: U601 harmonics in 216-960 MHz band
findings.description: U601 (TLV62569DBVR) switching at 0.5 MHz has 1489 harmonics in the 216-960 MHz band (harmonics 432-1920). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U601. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U601 harmonics in 216-960 MHz band

findings.title: U601 harmonic envelope
findings.description: U601 (TLV62569DBVR) switching at 0.50 MHz, duty ≈50%. Harmonic envelope: flat to 0.3 MHz, -20 dB/dec to 32 MHz, -40 dB/dec above. Harmonics extend into FCC test range starting at 60th harmonic.
findings.recommendation: Minimize the hot loop area (input cap → high-side switch → inductor → low-side switch → input cap). Every halving of loop area reduces emissions by 6 dB.
findings.summary: U601 harmonic envelope

findings.title: USB diff pair skew exceeds limit
findings.description: Differential pair USB_DP/USB_DM has 9.0mm length mismatch (49.4 ps skew). Exceeds USB limit of 25 ps by 98%.
findings.recommendation: Match trace lengths to within 12 ps (2.3mm). Use length-matched serpentine routing.
findings.summary: USB diff pair skew exceeds limit

findings.title: USB diff pair changes layers
findings.description: Net USB_DP (part of USB diff pair) transitions across 2 layers (B.Cu, F.Cu) with 3 via(s). Each layer transition is a potential DM-to-CM conversion point. Ensure stitching vias or decoupling caps at each transition.
findings.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias within 2× dielectric height of each signal via. Preferably route diff pairs on a single layer to avoid layer transitions entirely.
findings.summary: USB diff pair changes layers

findings.title: USB diff pair changes layers
findings.description: Net USB_DM (part of USB diff pair) transitions across 2 layers (B.Cu, F.Cu) with 4 via(s). Each layer transition is a potential DM-to-CM conversion point. Ensure stitching vias or decoupling caps at each transition.
findings.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias within 2× dielectric height of each signal via. Preferably route diff pairs on a single layer to avoid layer transitions entirely.
findings.summary: USB diff pair changes layers

findings.title: USB diff pair on outer layer
findings.description: Net USB_DP (USB diff pair) is 100% routed on outer layers. Inner stripline layers provide better shielding and lower radiation for high-speed differential pairs.
findings.recommendation: Route differential pairs on inner stripline layers when possible for reduced EMI.
findings.summary: USB diff pair on outer layer

findings.title: USB diff pair on outer layer
findings.description: Net USB_DM (USB diff pair) is 100% routed on outer layers. Inner stripline layers provide better shielding and lower radiation for high-speed differential pairs.
findings.recommendation: Route differential pairs on inner stripline layers when possible for reduced EMI.
findings.summary: USB diff pair on outer layer

top_issues.title: No EMC filtering near J201

top_issues.recommendation: Ensure J201 has proper ground connection to chassis/enclosure. Add ESD protection if connected to external antenna.
